# `srs find`

```text
Discover instances by structured filters + content search (ext:discovery)

Usage: srs find [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --text <TEXT>
          Free-text recall-floor search over the record's text projection

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --type <TYPE_FILTER>
          Exact match on type, in canonical `namespace/name` form (e.g. com.example/section). Alias for `--type-namespace` + `--type-name`; takes precedence over them when both are given

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --type-id <TYPE_ID>
          Exact match on Record.typeId

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --type-namespace <TYPE_NAMESPACE>
          Exact match on Record.typeNamespace

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --type-name <TYPE_NAME>
          Exact match on Record.typeName

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

      --tag <TAG>
          Tag predicate (repeatable; AND-conjunction — instance must carry all)

      --lifecycle-state <LIFECYCLE_STATE>
          Exact match on Record.lifecycleState (requires ext:lifecycle)

      --lifecycle-states <LIFECYCLE_STATES>
          Inclusive multi-value lifecycleState filter (repeatable; OR semantics — RFC-012 Rev 11). Independent of --lifecycle-state; do not combine the two

      --exclude-lifecycle-state <EXCLUDE_LIFECYCLE_STATE>
          Exclude records whose lifecycleState matches this value (repeatable; applied after --lifecycle-state)

      --tier <TIER>
          Instance tier filter (0=Note, 2=Record — Tier 1/TypedRecord is retired, srs#448/rfc-decision-53635966, srs-rust#888)

      --limit <LIMIT>
          Maximum hits to return (default: all; `total` always counts every match)

      --offset <OFFSET>
          Number of hits to skip, after the deterministic sort
          
          [default: 0]

      --rank
          Order --text hits by BM25 relevance (fills `score`) instead of by instanceId

      --match <MODE>
          How --text words combine: `all` (every word must occur) or `any` (any significant word, as a whole token; for questions typed as sentences; always ranked)
          
          [default: all]

      --by-type-limit <BY_TYPE_LIMIT>
          Cap on `facets.byType` values (default 20; the rest are summed into `other`). 0 = every type

      --facets [<BOOL>]
          Include `facets` (counts over the whole match set). Default: only with `--limit 0`, the repository map. `--facets false` drops them there too
          
          [possible values: true, false]

      --projection <PROJECTION>
          How much of each hit to return: `full` (default), `card` (id, uri, label, type, state, score, snippet) or `label` (id, uri, label, type, state)
          
          [default: full]

      --similar <INSTANCE_ID>
          More like this: instances similar to this instance (Record or Note id), ranked by BM25 over its top-weighted terms, excluding itself. The other filters narrow the candidates; not combinable with --text

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
